findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM).
findings.comment: The PIC is not a Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM), but stated that they are working on obtaining their CFPM certificate. Ensure that there is always a CFPM on duty during all hours of operation and food preparation.
findings.citation_text: 2-102.12(A) Certified Food Protection Manager. (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: There was observed to be a trash can in front of the bar handwashing sink. CORRECTED- The trash can was moved to another location and this was discussed with the PIC. Ensure that the handwashing sink is always maintained to be accessible at all times for employee use.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.11 Using a Handwashing Sink. (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present.
findings.comment: Inspectors observed multiple gnats in the onion container in the kitchen. PIC was informed about a possible spoiled onion causing the gnat accumulation. CORRECTED - PIC removed spoiled onion from the storage container. Ensure to inspect produce to prevent pest harborage conditions.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.111 (A)(B) and (D) Controlling Pests. The PREMISES shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests shall be controlled to eliminate their presence on the PREMISES by: (A) Routinely inspecting incoming shipments of FOOD and supplies; (B) Routinely inspecting the PREMISES for evidence of pests; and (D) Eliminating harborage conditions.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.comment: No sanitizer was observed to be made behind the bar while in operation. CORRECTED - Quaternary ammonium sanitizer was made in the triple sink and tested to be at a concentration of 200 ppm. Ensure that sanitizer is made and available at all times of operation and food preparation.
findings.citation_text: 4-303.11(B) Cleaning Agents and Sanitizers, Availability. (B) Except for those that are generated on-site at the time of use, chemical SANITIZERS that are used to sanitize EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS as specified under Part 4-7, shall be provided and available for use during all hours of operation.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment:
The following non food contact surfaces are observed to be in need of cleaning:

1. Walk in cooler fan covers.
2. Walk in cooler shelves.
3. Gaskets of the double door freezer closest to the kitchen.
4. Handles and doors of double door freezer across from the pass through in the kitchen.

This was discussed with PIC. Ensure that all food and non-food contact surfaces are cleaned and maintained cleaned.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
FIRST REPEAT- The following physical facilities were observed to be in need of repair:

Kitchen
-Seal holes in the wall across from white standing freezer
-Replace trim and seal corner of the trim of the hall going into the kitchen
-Seal base cove to wall to the left of the triple sink
-Seal weather stripping around the back door
-Seal wall around triple sink/around drain board
-Provide handle for inside of the walk-in cooler
-Sand down cutting board at mini prep cooler

Mop room
-Seal flaking drywall around plumbing protruding into kitchen space
-Seal/paint drywall paper
-Put Nudo board around the mop sink so wall is smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable 

Bar
-Finish flooring beneath the bars triple sink to the wall
-Seal the wall to the floor so it is smooth and easily cleanable

Basement
-Organize items stored in the basement
-Seal molded bricks

Ensure that physical facilities are repaired and maintained in good repair.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Allergen awareness training for CFPM
findings.comment:
Inspectors observed there to be no certified food production manager (CFPM) who has their allergen awareness training on site during the inspection. The PIC stated they are in the process of obtaining their certificate. Ensure that there are enough CFPMs with their allergen awareness training to cover all hours of operation and food preparation.  

410 ILCS 625/3.07(b). Allergen awareness training. (b) Unless otherwise provided, all certified food service sanitation managers employed by a restaurant must receive or obtain training in basic allergen awareness principles within 30 days after employment and every 3 years thereafter. Training programs must be accredited by the American National Standards Institute or another reputable accreditation agency under the ASTM International E2659-09 (Standard Practice for Certificate Programs). There is no limit to how many times an employee may take the training.
